finding_reviews.rationale: Coverage key is right (one fund-quarter, 2024-12-31), but the mechanism is wrong. F23 (pipeline/validate_fund_financials.py l.428 and l.587-592) sums pct_of_net_assets over ALL holdings rows, cash included; it does not use 'the summed reported percents of the non-cash rows' as the proposal statement says. On t7ae the published pct sum is 161.162 (160.6 non-cash + 0.562 bill) against FV/net assets 216.663. The page prints the bill at 56.2 % / 57.7 % and the inline tag is us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedPercentOfNetAssets 56.2 with scale -2 (instance 0.562); every other row is published in percent units (e.g. Mondee 16.6), the bill row alone is published at 0.562 / 0.577. Had the bill been published at 56.2 / 57.7 the sum would be about 216.8 / 214.6 and F23 would pass. So F23 is caused by a published pct scaling error on the CASH row (pipeline), which the 20-card page sample also found (card C014, 2024-12-31: 'prints 56.2%; tag 0.562 correct; published 0.562'). Conclusion should be confirmed_error with a pct-scaling fix for the cash row (or an explicit owner decision), not an as_filed proposal. Reason key f23-holdings-include-cash-rows-percent-sum-excludes-them is factually wrong. Related: the pct_of_net_assets_identity findings for the same two quarters were cleared by DS-FUNDLOOP-pct_of_net_assets_identity-1715933 ('check passed on t7ad'), which accepts this same mis-scaled value as filed.
